Multiple Road Accidents Claim Lives Across India and UAE

Multiple road accidents have resulted in fatalities across India and the UAE. In Andhra Pradesh, an SUV collided with a truck parked on the roadside, killing five people who were returning from a temple. In Bihar's Lakhisarai district, an SUV and a truck collided, resulting in five deaths and three injuries; the deceased were residents of Dhaka village in East Champaran and were en route to Deoghar. In Uttar Pradesh's Lakhimpur Kheri, a head-on collision between a truck and a car killed four people and left six seriously injured. Separately, in the UAE's Ras Al Khaimah Emirate, a bus-truck collision killed 11 people, occurring 12 days after another crash in the region that claimed 14 lives.
